response.query: Which domain-adaptation strategies (transfer learning, active learning, calibration, adversarial adaptation) best preserve NLP classifier performance across countries/sectors?
response.answer: Transfer learning and adversarial adaptation best preserve NLP classifier performance across countries/sectors. They effectively adjust models to new domains while maintaining accuracy.
